findings.title: Duplicate Policy Configuration Formats (JSON and YAML)

evidence.observation: Both config/self_improvement_policy.json and config/self_improvement_policy.yaml exist simultaneously in repository
YAML policy file coexists alongside JSON policy file, risking configuration divergence

proposed_action.description: Standardize on a single canonical configuration format for self-improvement policy and remove duplicate specification

findings.expected_benefit: Eliminates potential configuration drift and ambiguity across services consuming policy definitions

findings.title: Embedding Model Tag Specification Discrepancy

evidence.observation: Router policy configures 'embed' route with model name 'nomic-embed-text'
Ollama available models lists embedding model with explicit tag 'nomic-embed-text:latest'

proposed_action.description: Explicitly align model tag identifiers in model-router policy with available Ollama model tags

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures deterministic model resolution and prevents route failures due to tag mismatch
